panels.description: The tanker disappears beyond the terraces. Older Alex lowers his hand; no alarm sounds. Leave the lake horizon open.
The granddaughter kneels beside crooked TJ at the boathouse edge. Keep TJ's damaged leg visible and leave upper space for dialogue.
TJ drags his damaged leg toward the boathouse, wet parts clicking over the dock. Leave upper dock space for the soundless movement.
Older Alex turns toward TJ, his granddaughter behind the dog. Keep the emotional reaction quiet and leave upper third open.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Because I know what happens when people panic around water.
